name: Your Hair
overview: Scripture addresses the care and appearance of hair with specific instructions that reflect holiness and distinction before the Lord. Leviticus 19:28 warns against cutting the flesh or marking the body, which can be related to altering hair in ways that defile. Deuteronomy 22:5 emphasizes maintaining clear distinctions between men and women, which includes appropriate hair presentation. Ezekiel 44:20 directs that priests should neither shave their heads nor let their hair grow long but only trim it, illustrating a balanced approach to cutting hair that honors God’s commands.
